description: Resume a paused chat app bridge (PATCH /v1/bridges/{id} with paused: false). Needs a paid plan with room for one more running bridge: 402 on a plan without chat apps, 403 plan_limit when its running bridges are already at the limit (thalovant_get_bridge_networks shows the allowance). A bridge paused because the account was deactivated (hold account_suspended) resumes when the account is reactivated. A bridge with no chats yet (status Setup) starts only once thalovant_update_bridge sets allowed. Returns the bridge; status.reason turns Connected once it runs. Requires the hubs:write scope, and the hub's owner or a workspace manager.

apiUrl.description: Control-plane base URL. Configured credentials may only be used on their configured origin; defaults to https://api.thalovant.com.

bridgeId.description: Bridge UUID: the id from thalovant_list_bridges.

etag.description: Optional. The bridge's etag, read from the `etag` field of thalovant_get_bridge (the API sends no ETag header), sent as If-Match: a bridge changed since fails with HTTP 412 and nothing changes. Leave it out to change the bridge as it is now.

loginScope.description: Optional login scope used with THALOVANT_EMAIL and THALOVANT_PASSWORD.

name: thalovant_resume_bridge
title: Resume Chat App Bridge
